source.name: measured vapour pressures (NIST TRC ThermoML Archive) and the critical point
source.fit: Fitted to measured vapour pressures (NIST TRC ThermoML Archive): 88 values with stated uncertainties within 1 % from 1 articles, max deviation 0.64 %, and 35 values with larger stated uncertainties, kept where the fit is within them (they extend the range to 303.59 K); and the ChemSep v8.3 pure-component database critical point (850.00 K, 6660000 Pa). Between 547.25 K and the critical point the curve is held only by the critical point. The ChemSep vapour-pressure equation was not used: it deviates from the values within 1 % by +4.4 % (median, +14.4 % at most); see docs/MEASURED_CHECKS.md. Articles: Verevkin et al., Fluid Phase Equilib. 397 (2015) 87-94, doi:10.1016/j.fluid.2015.03.038; Veneral et al., J. Chem. Thermodyn. 58 (2013) 398-404, doi:10.1016/j.jct.2012.09.032; Zaoui-Djelloul-Daouadji et al., J. Chem. Thermodyn. 69 (2014) 165-171, doi:10.1016/j.jct.2013.09.046; Aniya et al., J. Chem. Eng. Data 61 (2016) 1850-1863, doi:10.1021/acs.jced.5b01080; Mokbel et al., J. Chem. Eng. Data 57 (2012) 284-289, doi:10.1021/je200766t; Yan and Suppes, J. Chem. Eng.
